## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The running status should display the same revision identifier as deployment history so readers can match the two outputs.

## Changes
The pull request adds a running deployment status formatter that displays an abbreviated revision and the attempt number.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/display.py:14 — correctness — Use the history revision identifier in running status — For revision `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`, running status shows `0123456` while history shows `0123456789ab`. The docstring promises “the same identifier as history,” but status uses `revision[:7]` and history uses `revision[:12]`. — For revisions longer than seven characters, readers cannot match the running status to the history entry by exact identifier. — Fix: Extend `test_running_status_contains_attempt` to check the full status line.
